text:
val: Quick flag from console QA: stacked modal + toast interaction is still flaky. Repro: open Settings modal -> open Edit API Key modal -> trigger 'key saved' toast while the editor finishes rendering. Sometimes ESC closes both.

mai: Are toasts getting programmatic focus? We switched that a while back but might be back in a refactor.

val: Yep, code calls `element.focus()` in toaster when toast includes dismiss button.

rob: Two problems to solve: announcement strategy (role/status vs alert) and ESC scoping. If toast momentarily gets focus our ModalManager global ESC listener closes the top modal.

sasha: Proposal: stop focusing the toast container; add `role="status" aria-live="polite"` and keep a tabbable dismiss. Also change ModalManager ESC handler to check `document.activeElement` and ignore ESC when focus is inside `[data-toast]`.

mai: +1. Also add an e2e: stacked modal -> toast -> press ESC -> expect modal still open. QA needs that.

access-bot: checklist: ensure toasts use aria-live for non-critical messages, dismiss button is keyboard accessible, ESC handlers respect event.defaultPrevented.

val: I'll open a small PR with `no-focus-toast` patch and tests. Assigning @sasha for a11y review.

rob: Heads-up: runtime folks may need to audit other global keyboard listeners.

val: thanks — will follow up with PR link.
